## Review checks

- [ ] Relevant regression tests are included, or the documentation-only scope is explained.
- [ ] Existing Hermes provider/profile settings and approval boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Manifest, docs, installed skill and catalog declarations agree where affected.
- [ ] No credentials, private customer inputs or unredacted sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] New dependencies, licenses, network destinations or persisted data are disclosed.

Do not attach vulnerability details publicly. Use the reporting guidance in
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for suspected security issues.
